items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy was sitting there in his shirt-sleeves

ctx.x: Yeah, that was fun. He was sitting out on the lawn. He had brought up a lot of these New Orleans cooks. They had tables all over the lawn of the White House. Man, we were eating up a storm. Good jambalaya, gumbo, spare ribs, red beans and rice. All the goodies, all the New Orleans goodies. It was just beautiful. Jimmy was sitting there in his shirt-sleeves and was listening to the music, and Dizzy had him come up and sing
